title: Shark Attacks
text:
The Global Shark Attack File collects reports of shark encounters around the world. It helps researchers and the public explore where attacks occur, what activities were involved, and whether incidents were fatal.
Fear of sharks is often out of proportion to the actual risk. Shark attacks are rare, and most encounters do not result in injury or death, even though sharks receive attention in news and popular culture.
Use the Map page to see shark attacks by country, and the Trends page to explore patterns in attacks over time and across activities, including the share of fatal and non-fatal incidents.
